name: Yoga with Sensei
source:
After saving money from years of hard work, Yuto Nakamura moves to the city to pursue an unusual dream, opening his own yoga studio. It’s a fresh start, but also a risky one. To succeed, he’ll need students… and a little luck.

Soon, four women with completely different personalities step into Yuto’s studio. What begins as simple yoga lessons slowly turns into something more as daily routines, playful banter, and intimate moments bring everyone closer together.

Your choices shape how relationships grow, leading to multiple romance routes and endings. Will Yuto find love with one student, end up alone, or balance feelings with everyone at once?

[From [url=https://rmtradingsgamestudio.itch.io/yoga-with-sensei]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过多年的努力攒够了钱，中村佑斗搬到了城市去追求一个不寻常的梦想，开设了自己的瑜伽工作室。这是一个新的开始，但也是一个冒险的开始。为了成功，他需要学生……还有一点运气。

很快，四位性格完全不同的女性走进了佑斗的工作室。一开始只是简单的瑜伽课程，随着日常生活、有趣的玩笑和亲密的时刻让每个人的联系变得更加紧密，慢慢地变得更加丰富。

你的选择决定了关系的发展方式，从而导致多种浪漫路线和结局。裕斗会爱上一名学生，最终会孤独终老，还是会同时与所有人平衡感情？

[来自[url=https://rmtradingsgamestudio.itch.io/yoga-with-sensei]itch.io[/url]]
